assumptions.statement: role-duration-seconds is not set and the configure-aws-credentials default of 3600 s is verified only for the refs in configure_aws_credentials.yaml.
SCPs, RCPs, session policies and permission boundaries that were not supplied are not modelled; Allow results may over-approximate.
With id-token: write, any step can request an OIDC token through the runner URL and bearer environment variables.
Whether a repository mints classic or immutable subjects is unknown from files, so both are evaluated; declare [github] subject_format to settle it.
A repository writer can edit a workflow on a branch, add id-token: write, and request the default AWS audience; branch protection and actor permissions are not present in repository files.
When the requested session duration is not declared or cannot be read, a session is assumed to last at most the role max_session_duration (1 h when unset, 12 h when the role maximum is unknown).
A rotation resource means periodic rotation; the next rotation time is unknown, so survival is reported as up to N days.
Whether a secret or parameter holds a credential, and of what kind, is inferred from resource type and name patterns.
